data.name: Oahu Grand Circle Island Tour – Waimea Valley & Dole Plantation (7B)
data.headline: Daily 7:00-5:45
data.description:
Embark on a captivating journey through the enchanting island of Oahu, immersing yourself in its mesmerizing landscapes and cultural treasures. Immerse yourself in the experience while we handle the driving for you in our deluxe touring vehicle. Throughout the tour, our knowledgeable local guide shares captivating Hawaiian history, legends, and insider tips, enriching your exploration.

Our day-long adventure begins in Honolulu and winds along the breathtaking south shore, leading you to the iconic north shore—a must-experience for all ages.

Throughout the tour, our knowledgeable local guide shares captivating Hawaiian history, legends, and insider tips, enriching your exploration.

Witness the majestic Diamond Head and Kahala's Gold Coast, drive past the epic shore break at Sandy’s and Makapu’u Beaches, and marvel at the natural spectacle of the Halona Blowhole, if parking is available.

Take in panoramic views at Nu’uanu Pali Lookout and find serenity amidst the sprawling gardens of Byodo-In Japanese Temple. See Mokoli’i Island from a distance. A refreshing swim awaits at Waimea Valley's natural waterfall-fed pool, weather permitting.

Lunch is your own adventure, offering flexibility to savor local flavors as you please. Continue the journey past legendary Sunset and Waimea Bay Beaches. Explore Haleiwa Town's charm and uncover the origins of the pineapple at a brief stop at Dole Plantation before concluding this unforgettable day of discovery.

Immerse yourself in Oahu’s wonders, from historic landmarks to the natural beauty that defines this captivating island paradise.
data.highlights:

#About the Oahu Grand Circle Island Tour - includes Nuuanu Pali, Byodo-In, Waimea Valley, Haleiwa, & Dole Plantation
This grand circle island tour offers an immersive 120-mile excursion around beautiful Oahu, including must-see landmarks and scenic vistas. This sightseeing experience offers live narration, convenient Waikiki pickups and breathes life to the rich Hawaiian history of Oahu. Known as the gathering place, we welcome all to view the rocky south shore cliffs with breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean to the windward coastline's verdant rainforests to the famous north shore's pristine white sandy beaches and legendary surf. Explore verdant and sacred Waimea Valley, take an optional roundtrip tram ride to the top of the valley and swim in the waterfall fed pool as weather permits. Treat yourself to a Dole Whip at Dole Plantation before heading back with memories that'll last long after your vacation. 

*Lunch will now be at your leisure, allowing you greater flexibility on tour.*

**Please see our contact information below, if you have any other questions.**
